title: Push delivery and update check join the tracker; dashboard row
goal: Repeated push delivery failures and update-check failures notify the owner the same way, and the dashboard lists every failing class
acceptance: One failing-first test per class (push, update check)
The dashboard health view shows each class that is failing now, with its first failure time
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: two classes on the T02 tracker and one view row. Not a measurement.
